items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I worked with Lucky Thompson for a while. ... That was back on 52nd Street.

ctx.x: I want to get some sense of the early sense of music or where the roots of your music talents, in the sense that: was it the family? Was it in Thompson Methodist Church, where you used to go?
Yeah, that’s it. Thompson’s Church. Thompson’s Methodist Church . . .
